title: sokf harness report
description: The report of `sokf harness install --json` and `sokf harness status --json`: one entry for each harness named, in sokf's order of the harnesses, with one entry for each part (CLI-3_AC-20).

warnings.description: The content that an agent may load twice.

Scope.description: Where a harness integration is installed.

oneOf.description: The project: files beside the project's own files.
The user: files under the home directory, in each harness's own configuration directory.
The project's local, git-ignored files (e.g. `.claude/settings.local.json`), under the project root.

harness.description: The name of the harness, for example `claude`.

parts.description: The parts, in the harness's order.

unsupported.description: The items of sokf's integration that the harness has no place for at the scope, for example `permissions`.

notes.description: What the user still has to do in the agent, for example trust the folder.

part.description: The name of the part, for example `skills` or `hooks`.

state.description: The state in which the command found the part, before it wrote anything: `skipped`, `shared`, `absent`, `current`, `stale`, or `edited`.

action.description: For `install`, what the command did to the part: `created`, `rewrote`, or `updated`. The key is absent when the command left the part as it found it, and always for `status`.

path.description: The file or directory to which the command writes the part: a path from the repository root, which starts with `/`, or at the user scope a path from the home directory, which starts with `~/`. For a shared part, the location that another harness writes.

by.description: For a shared part, the harness whose part writes it. The key is absent for every other part.

oneOf.description: Another harness's part puts the same content in a location this harness loads; nothing is written for it.
The file, the block or the entries are not there.
Differs from the tool's content and equals the recorded hash: the tool wrote it and has changed since.
Differs from both, or present with no recorded hash.

Action.description: What install did to a part.

oneOf.description: A region or merge part written into the existing file, or an external part written again.
Left by uninstall because other installed harnesses, named in `by`, still read it.

Item.description: One kind of thing in an integration. An item becomes at most one part per harness, named by the item's name (e.g. `hooks`).
